name: verify-email
title: Verify email
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Check your email, resend after a cooldown, and optionally enter the code.

files.content:
/**
 * Clean-room copy for password recovery and email verification.
 * One sentence per outcome. Nothing here takes an "account exists" flag.
 */

export type AuthLocale = "es-MX" | "en"

const LEAK =
  /no account|not found|does not exist|doesn't exist|no existe|sin cuenta|no encontramos|unknown user|user not found|correo no registrado|email not registered/i

export function recoveryCopyLeaksAccount(text: string) {
  return LEAK.test(text)
}

export function recoverySentBody(locale: AuthLocale) {

}

api.name: onResend
api.description: Sends another message. The card waits cooldownSeconds before it can run again.

api.name: onVerifyCode
api.description: Optional. True confirms the code. False is a mismatch. A throw becomes a generic error.

api.name: onVerified
api.description: Called after the code is accepted.

api.name: otp
api.description: Shows the code field. Also shown when onVerifyCode is set.

api.name: email
api.description: Address the person typed. Shown as entered, not as proof of an account.

api.name: skipHref / onSkip
api.description: Optional way to leave verification for later.

api.name: cooldownSeconds / initialCooldown
api.description: How long resend stays disabled, and how much of that wait is already elapsed.

api.name: locale / labels / phase
api.description: Language, copy overrides, and a locked scene.

docs: Clean-room. shadcn/studio verify-email (Free and Pro) was not copied: the Free tier adds the Commons Clause, which blocks redistribution in a component library, and Pro was not purchased. No source, sample data, icons, or strings were copied. The code field reuses otp-field, including its cooldown pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Resend and failure copy do not reveal whether an account exists (proposed hub rule RUI-AUTH-ENUM-001).
